Nov 14 pass rates, same keyless sandbox:

Claude Code 343/371
Grok Build 354/386
Codex 95/119
Cursor 32/54
Pi 86/140

Not a ranking of the agents. It shows how completely add-ons ship for each one.
https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/reports/2026-11-14/

How we label a night of install tests, from the Nov 14 report:

Needs an API key (25): not broken; our sandbox has no keys on purpose.
Flaky (9): flip-flopped recently.
Broken: fails 2 nights in a row after a retry.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/how-we-test/

Built a skill, plugin or MCP server? Submit it free: we install it nightly in Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor and Pi, and publish the logs.

Most tools listed for one agent turn out to work in two or three more.
https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/submit/

Nov 22 install tests: 831 of 1,085 installs passed across Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor and Pi, in a clean sandbox with no API keys. 15 only needed a key. 36 failed once and get re-checked before we call them broken.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/reports/2026-11-22/

Nov 22 pass rates, same keyless sandbox:

Claude Code 329/374
Grok Build 341/389
Codex 79/122
Pi 68/143
Cursor 14/57

Not a ranking of the agents. The add-on mix differs per agent.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/reports/2026-11-22/

Pending vs broken, Nov 22 run: 36 installs failed once after a retry but had passed the night before. We call those pending. Broken means failing two nights in a row, since one bad night can be a registry blip.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/how-we-test/

Cursor shows 14 of 57 in our Nov 22 run. Our Cursor suite is MCP-only and smaller than the others, tested in a keyless sandbox. It measures what installs cleanly there, not how good Cursor is.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/reports/2026-11-22/

Wondering if a skill or MCP server installs today? Type its name into the check on our latest report and pick your agent. The answer comes from last night's real install in a clean sandbox, not a README.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/reports/latest/

Why our sandbox has no API keys, on purpose: if a tool installs there, it installs for anyone. In the Nov 22 run, 15 installs only failed because they asked for a key. We list them separately so a missing token never counts as broken.

https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/how-we-test/
